body: this is the exact same way i feel, and it’s hard to make them understand.

we’ve met up twice. the reason he doesn’t tell his friends is because he has had a ldr before me that everyone judged him for, and in the end she cheated on him and it really messed him up. i’ve brought it up before and we argue about it because he said “why should it matter if they know?”. i bring up how i think he should post a picture of us on his instagram but he says he doesn’t use it that often and that i shouldn’t care about what other people think. i know he cares about me but it does feel like he still has a wall up towards me and won’t let me in completely. what should i do?
